title: Remove field enumeration from multiplication tensor reconstruction (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped constructive proof with exact finite corroboration. The new algorithm recognizes tensors isotopic to commutative unital algebra multiplication in deterministic O(n^7) exact field operations and returns the multiplication table and all three invertible factor maps. It removes the field-scalar enumeration in the regular-module step of Ali Romman / PR5540. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

```text
nucleus -> quotient-annihilator saturation -> two cyclic generators
        -> recovered multiplication table and U,V,W
```

For a supplied algebra A and module M, the explicit scan computes the unique largest cyclic idempotent e and a generator of eM in at most dim(M) coordinate probes. General cyclicity algorithms are established, including Lenstra and Silverberg's 2015 finite-ring theorem. The new repository contribution is the specified saturation constructor, its uniform reconstruction application and operation bound. Credit PR5540 and its retained apoursh / PR5502, Nick Petalas / PR5252 and David Ganz lineage. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence and reproduction

Before, PR5540's stated algorithm has polynomial complexity for fixed prime and uses primitive decomposition with scalar enumeration. After, the new reconstruction has O(n^7) field-operation complexity over any supplied exact field, with no scalar enumeration, polynomial factorization or primitive decomposition. PROOF.md supplies the quantified argument.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 checks pass:

- All 16,418 candidate actions in the specified quadratic-algebra grid over F2/F3/F5. Every one of the 750 valid modules agrees with literal enumeration of all vectors and idempotents: 712 cyclic modules, 28 proper nonzero cyclic parts and ten zero cyclic parts.
- 85 additional constructed module fixtures and 75 independent-basis tensor presentations through characteristic 65537; 630 transported basis products pass the separate certificate checker. Ten nonregular tensors, 75 altered output maps and ten explicit controls reject.
- Fifteen additional scalar boundary cases pass. Three disposable optimized source mutations reject: vector annihilator in place of quotient annihilator, unsaturated ideal, and an unproved full cyclic part.
- Both warning-strict registered commands, complete package replay, syntax/function-size checks and whitespace checks pass. Direct command durations are 0.540s and 0.542s; both are below one second and their 120-second limits.
- Exact nine-file committed bytes and declared source ancestry pass. Official committed export integrity and input coverage pass. Normal and optimized Git-free replay from a read-only ten-file export, including export metadata, pass with empty PATH and unchanged bytes/modes. Generated hash-bound receipts agree across both modes and the export.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/cyclic-module-saturation/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/cyclic-module-saturation/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cyclic-module-saturation
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cyclic-module-saturation --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace that path. Expected markers are PASS_CYCLIC_MODULE_SATURATION, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES. No predecessor executable or scientific suite is imported or replayed. Registered local obligations are complete; none is deferred solely to CI.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The operation count assumes a supplied exact field and counts field operations. It neither constructs that field nor bounds rational coefficient growth or rational bit complexity. The bounded reference handles prime p<=65537, algebra/module dimensions through eight and tensor dimensions through four. Extension-field and rational input layers are not implemented.

The output is a recovered algebra and isotopy, not a general algebra-isomorphism classification, prescribed local presentation, height list or determinant-one orbit label. No physical/native coefficient realization, complete paid caller/restoration bill, compiler/ownership/precision/tape/analytic admission, full multiplication theorem, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is supplied. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can one accepted table and its transporter be implemented within an affordable complete native caller? First declare and charge every coefficient map, arbitrary dirty input, native action, return and restoration. No such physical cost contract is supplied by recognition.

## Related open work

- [PR6422](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6422) studies least-subfield norm witnesses for determinant corrections in the multiplication-tensor lineage. This package reconstructs a general commutative multiplication table; it computes no norm-witness minimum, so no common numerical optimum is compared.

Merged PR6303 accelerates a separate bounded extension-field recognizer's row kernel. Its workload and measured runtime are not inherited or rechecked here. Main README/general-form searches, merged/all-state searches, current open PRs and live claims found no matching saturation-reconstruction result in inspected coverage. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain outside coverage. Canonical main remained 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a at the submission refresh. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362864).

The completion refresh inspected this account's fifteen open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this PR. The fourteen others study different objects or workloads; none computes this reconstruction's operation bound or maximal cyclic summand. The PR6422 line above remains the related multiplication-tensor work. No shared-instance numerical disagreement was identified, and no extra computation checked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `4dccee2d93aab5115e1c7458019bb78c919aaa3b` in [Registered research packages run 41550494860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41550494860): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41550494860/job/125636583606) in 4m33s and [replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41550494860/job/125638485024) in 1m22s. The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head.

Hosted replay executes the registered normal and optimized finite checks and source metadata validation. All local checks listed above also passed. Automated execution does not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the quantified written proof. Physical implementation, supplier admission and the five selected framework assumptions retain their stated status.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated nine-file research package and its opt-in replay. Shared code, frozen sources, predecessor credit and the selected record retain their bytes.
